materials_exhausted.note: The source/supplementary directory is empty, but the OA package contains mmc1.docx; Tables S1-S3 were parsed from that DOCX. Figure-only curves were not digitized beyond exact values stated in text/tables.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework rebuilt Tables 2 and 3 into row-level activity/toxicity evidence, parsed the local DOCX supplement tables, reconciled DBAASP rows against primary locators, and preserves nonblocking database label/value conflicts as cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions: linked DBAASP rows were matched where local primary values support them; database peptide_name labels that prepend sC184B and condition-specific database MIC rows without standalone primary values remain preserved as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted: primary XML Table 2 MIC values, Table 3 HC50/CC50/GM/SI values, DOCX Table S2 MIC fold-changes, FICI prose/figure values, and exact biofilm inhibition percentages were converted into locator-backed rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with cautions: direct membrane-disruption assays are separated from computational AAMD support and phenotype-level time-kill/biofilm/synergy effects.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Structural packet remains material_extracted_with_gaps because supplementary_index did not enumerate files, but the recoverable OA-package DOCX was reopened and parsed; no blocking local material gap remains for worker-2/4/6 acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP peptide_name values often prepend sC184B to primary Table 1 compound labels; this was not normalized away.
Some DBAASP salt/plasma condition MIC rows are not standalone primary table cells; exact source-supported fold-change/prose values are retained while database rows stay source_conflict.
No exact numeric values were invented from figure-only curves; only source text/tables/DOCX tables contributed exact rows.
